chunkmap.config.title: ChunkMap Configuration
chunkmap.config.outputDir.tooltip: Directory for exported tiles (relative to game folder).
chunkmap.config.colorMode.tooltip: MAP_COLOR: vanilla map palette. TEXTURE_AVERAGE: average texture color.
chunkmap.config.shadeByHeight.tooltip: Apply directional lighting based on terrain height.
chunkmap.config.uiAnimation.tooltip: Enable smooth animations in the map UI.
chunkmap.config.deleteOnUnload.tooltip: Delete tile files when a chunk is unloaded.
chunkmap.config.githubToken.tooltip: Optional. Personal Access Token (Issues: Read and Write) to submit feedback in-game. Leave blank to use the built-in default or copy manually.
chunkmap.config.githubToken.hint: Stored locally in config/chunkmap.json. Revoke anytime at github.com/settings/tokens.
chunkmap.config.renderThreads.tooltip: Number of worker threads for tile rendering. Changes apply immediately after reload.
chunkmap.config.logRetentionDays.tooltip: Auto-delete logs older than this many days. 0 = never.
chunkmap.config.debug.password.tooltip: Enter the correct password and save to unlock debug options.
chunkmap.config.debug.password.hint: Hint: the password is a fixed string set by the developer. Regular players don't need this.
chunkmap.config.debug.locked: 🔒 Debug options are locked. Enter the correct password to unlock.
chunkmap.config.debug.unlocked: 🔓 Debug mode unlocked. All changes take effect immediately after saving.
chunkmap.config.debug.logLevel.tooltip: Runtime log level. TRACE is verbose, OFF disables everything.
chunkmap.config.debug.overlay.tooltip: Show FPS / cache / queue debug info on the map screen.
chunkmap.config.debug.lock.tooltip: Enable and save to re-lock debug options.
chunkmap.config.debug.showChunkBorders.t: Draw a magenta grid on top of the map to visualize chunk boundaries.
chunkmap.config.debug.showTileCoords.too: Label each tile with its chunk (x,z) coordinates. Only visible when zoomed in.
chunkmap.config.debug.showPlayerChunk.to: Draw a yellow rectangle around the player's current chunk.
chunkmap.config.debug.showOrigin.tooltip: Draw a red crosshair at the center of the map texture.
chunkmap.config.debug.showHighlight.tool: Outline the tile under the mouse cursor.
chunkmap.config.debug.noGrid.tooltip: Hide the chunk grid overlay drawn on top of the map.
chunkmap.config.debug.wireframe.tooltip: Do not draw the map texture, only the grid and overlays.
chunkmap.config.debug.showFps.tooltip: Display the current FPS in the debug overlay.
chunkmap.config.debug.showMemory.tooltip: Display JVM heap usage in the debug overlay.
chunkmap.config.debug.showQueue.tooltip: Display render queue size and cache size.
chunkmap.config.debug.showTimings.toolti: Display the last texture rebuild time (ms).
chunkmap.config.debug.forceRebuild.toolt: Rebuild the map texture every frame. Very slow, debug only.
chunkmap.config.about.hint: Alt+M to open this screen. M to open the map. Map buttons: Star / Feedback / Logs / Export.
